summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a 424B5 pricing supplement for $1,349,000 of Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due September 30, 2032, linked to the worst-performing of the Dow Jones Industrial Average, Nasdaq-100 and Russell 2000 indices. Notes price $1,000 each, pay a contingent monthly coupon of $7.08 while the worst-performing underlying is at or above its barrier, are monthly autocallable from September 2027, and carry principal loss below threshold. This is a routine Series A medium-term note takedown under an existing shelf, not a special situation; watch index levels versus barriers.
